question: Does repeated R10AS differential support-gap minimization progress to the foot hull in its original fixed support mode, or which declared constraint stops this model before native implementation?

population.selection: Only R10AP partial entry step1 / semantic step513; all later poses are counterfactual model states, never replayed or native observations.
population.coverage: R10AS only showed one admitted front-limb motion with95mm gap remaining. This finite extension checks continued progress within that exact support mode over at most the existing600-step rise horizon; it does not discover or qualify a new physical population.

algorithm.fixed_support: Use only R10AS selected indices throughout: one torso point and both rear-foot points. Every initial and proposed static LP uses this same subset. Other original contact markers never acquire force, even when geometrically retained or moved above the floor.
algorithm.linear_and_nonlinear_law: Same R10AS differential hull-gap objective, coordinate bounds,0.02-rad nonworsening headroom, positive-contact non-descent,24 shape witness floor guards, loaded-contact projection and11 dyadic backtracking scales. Keep all four nonzero nodes per admitted step.
algorithm.global_guard: Additionally compare support drift, original-marker descent and shape penetration against original entry geometry at every node, tolerance1e-9, so per-step tolerance cannot accumulate into a changed anchor or floor.
algorithm.rebase: Apply exact chosen retraction to callback body transforms, mass centers and positive original contact markers. Preserve relative transforms and body-space point identities, accumulate canonical joint increments, then linearize again. Packet-shaped internal inputs explicitly carry counterfactual_model_only; original native provenance is not regenerated or asserted for them.
algorithm.step_equivalence: First selected increment and gap must reproduce R10AS within1e-10.
algorithm.termination: Stop on first refusal, hull gap<=1e-6 m, or600 accepted model steps. Retain complete attempts, refused scales, certificates, state geometry and headroom. A hull-gap stop is geometric only and does not establish physical foot support.
algorithm.no_tuning: No altered modes, friction, objective, bounds, margins, deadlines or failure interpretations after this result is exposed.

checks: Original17 manufactured R10AS controls plus5 global anchor/floor/drift negative controls before evaluation.
Independent original entry contact replay. No synthetic state is passed to the native replay authenticator.
Every rebase reconstructs contact markers,24 floor witnesses and mass COM within1e-12 of the selected prior pose.
Every static/differential LP retains checked primal and dual certificates from the pinned R10AR implementation.
limitations: One fixed contact mode. Retains R10AS non-descent rule even for unloaded markers; does not permit landing, sliding, lifting/replacing a support or body-ground contact changes. Discrete node checks do not prove continuous swept collision or interbody clearance. No inertia, native motor realization, physical runtime, controller selection or recovery success is implied.
